🚀 simplex-chat | Haskell
🎯 Primary Use Case: Secure and private communication without relying on user accounts or identifiers.
✨ Key Features: • No user identifiers of any kind • 100% private by design • Double ratchet end-to-end encryption • Additional encryption layer • Mobile apps for Android and iOS
📖 Summary: SimpleX Chat is a privacy-focused messaging platform that operates without any user identifiers, ensuring 100% privacy by design. It offers end-to-end encryption with an additional layer and provides mobile applications for iOS and Android, as well as a terminal-based client.
